I've posted quite a bit on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/linogaliana/) {{< fa brands linkedin >}} since 2022, and since no social platform's longevity is ever guaranteed (⚰️ RIP `Twitter` {{< fa brands twitter >}}), I'd rather keep my own archive of these *posts*:

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    var toggle = event.target.closest(".li-post-toggle");
    if (!toggle) return;

    var post = toggle.closest(".li-post");
    var teaser = post.querySelector(".li-post-teaser");
    var full = post.querySelector(".li-post-full");
    var expanded = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";

    expanded = !expanded;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(expanded));
    toggle.querySelector(".li-post-toggle-label").textContent = expanded ? "Show less" : "Show more";
    if (teaser) teaser.hidden = expanded;
    full.hidden = !expanded;
});
</script>
```

```{python}
import csv
import html
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

URL_RE = re.compile(r'https?://[^\s<>"]+')
HASHTAG_RE = re.compile(r'(?<!\w)#([A-Za-zÀ-ÖØ-öø-ÿ0-9_]+)')
TEASER_LEN = 180


def clean_commentary(text):
    """Undo LinkedIn's export artifact: each line is wrapped in stray
    quotes (e.g. 'foo"\\n""\\n"bar' instead of 'foo\\n\\nbar')."""
    text = re.sub(r'"(?=\n)|(?<=\n)"', "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def linkify(text):
    text = html.escape(text, quote=False)

    def repl_url(m):
        url = m.group(0)
        trailing = ""
        while url and url[-1] in ".,;:!?)\"'":
            trailing = url[-1] + trailing
            url = url[:-1]
        return f'<a href="{url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="li-post-url">{url}</a>{trailing}'

    text = URL_RE.sub(repl_url, text)
    text = HASHTAG_RE.sub(r'<span class="li-post-hashtag">#\1</span>', text)
    return text


def truncate(text, length):
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text, False
    cut = text[:length].rsplit(" ", 1)[0]
    return cut + "…", True


def post_html(row):
    dt = datetime.strptime(row["Date"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    date_str = dt.strftime("%d %B %Y")
    link = row["ShareLink"]

    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in clean_commentary(row["ShareCommentary"]).split("\n\n") if p.strip()]
    title, *body_paragraphs = paragraphs
    body_text = "\n\n".join(body_paragraphs)

    teaser_html = ""
    full_html = ""
    toggle_html = ""
    if body_text:
        teaser, truncated = truncate(body_text, TEASER_LEN)
        teaser_html = f'<p class="li-post-teaser">{linkify(teaser)}</p>'
        full_paragraphs = "".join(f"<p>{linkify(p)}</p>" for p in body_paragraphs)
        full_html = f'<div class="li-post-full" hidden>{full_paragraphs}</div>'
        toggle_html = (
            '<button type="button" class="li-post-toggle" aria-expanded="false">'
            '<span class="li-post-toggle-arrow">▸</span> '
            '<span class="li-post-toggle-label">Show more</span>'
            "</button>"
        )

    return f"""<div class="li-post">
        <div class="li-post-head">
            <span class="li-post-date">{date_str}</span>
            <a class="li-post-link" href="{link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">LinkedIn ↗</a>
        </div>
        <p class="li-post-title">{linkify(title)}</p>
        {teaser_html}
        {full_html}
        {toggle_html}
    </div>"""


with open("shares.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(f) if r["ShareCommentary"].strip()]

by_year = defaultdict(list)
for row in rows:
    year = row["Date"][:4]
    by_year[year].append(row)
```

```{python}
#| label: "linkedin-posts"
#| id: "linkedin-posts"
#| output: asis
for year in sorted(by_year.keys(), reverse=True):
    display(Markdown(f"## {year}" + "{#" + f"linkedin-{year}" + "}"))
    display(HTML("\n".join(post_html(row) for row in by_year[year])))
```
